title: galinsoga brachiata
intro: Galinsoga brachiata, commonly known as Mexican tea or Galinsoga, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) native to Mexico and Central America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and fever, as well as its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Galinsoga brachiata include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as urinary tract infections and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Galinsoga brachiata include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
